confidence_notes: The FX rate comes from an RBA search result: 0.6720 USD per AUD on 18 November 2026. I ran one search on food and drink prices, which returned aggregated cost-of-living sites (MyLifeElsewhere, Expat Exchange, Expatistan). Beer, coffee, inexpensive meal and mid-range meal are anchored on those figures. I ran no direct cocktail or wine search. Cocktail is estimated at about 3x beer, based on typical Pub Street happy-hour and standard bar pricing. Wine by the glass is imported, so I set it at roughly 3.5x beer. Accommodation is a holistic estimate from general knowledge, with no booking pages checked. It varies a lot by season, and July is low season.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to other low-cost Southeast Asian tourist hubs such as Luang Prabang, Hoi An and Battambang, with Siem Reap's tourist-area pricing near Pub Street.
